preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in lines[0].split())
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains two space-separated integers x and y representing the grid dimensions.
The dimensions x (width) and y (height) are between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == y and all(len(row) == x for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly y lines following the dimensions, each containing exactly x integers representing cell heights.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h <= 999 for row in grid for h in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell height h_ij is an integer between 0 and 999 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of the count of cells that can pool water, where a cell pools water if no path exists from it to any cell of strictly lower height via adjacent cells of height less than or equal to the current cell's height.

postconditions.expression: count_pool_cells(grid, x, y) == sum(1 for r in range(y) for c in range(x) if not can_flow_to_lower(grid, x, y, r, c))
postconditions.description: The count is the number of cells (r, c) such that there is no sequence of adjacent cells starting at (r, c) where each step moves to a neighbor with height <= current height, ending at a cell with height strictly less than the starting cell's height.
